desktop.title: Universal Filament Manager
desktop.heading: Local filament inventory
desktop.remove_printer_confirmation: Remove the connection for “{name}” and its saved access code? Print history and related records will remain in the database. If it is printing now, wait until the print finishes.
desktop.printer_removed_result: The connection for “{name}” and its access code were removed. Historical records were preserved.
desktop.printer_remove_failed: Could not safely remove the connection or its credentials. The printer remains in the list.
desktop.discovery_confirmation: Search network {network}? UFM will check only the OctoPrint (80), Moonraker (7125), and possible Bambu MQTT/TLS (8883) ports. No credentials are sent and no printer controls are used.
desktop.discovery_results_notice: Select a device to prefill its setup form. For Bambu, UFM can match the TLS certificate to a Bambu Studio profile and safely import available details.
desktop.discovery_select_printer: Select a device from the list first.
desktop.discovery_no_printers: No supported devices found. Ensure they are on this local network and reachable on a standard port.
desktop.discovery_failed: Could not complete local network device discovery.
printer.discovery_windows_only: Automatic discovery is currently available only on Windows.
printer.discovery_network_unavailable: Could not determine the primary Windows local network.
printer.discovery_private_lan_only: Discovery is limited to a private local network.
printer.discovery_network_too_large: The discovery network must be limited to at most 256 addresses; narrow the subnet.
desktop.bambu_studio_imported: Details were filled from Bambu Studio. The access code remains hidden; TLS is verified against the chain and this printer's exact fingerprint.
desktop.bambu_studio_enter_ip: Find the printer on the local network first or enter its IP address.
desktop.bambu_studio_invalid_host: Enter the Bambu printer's private LAN IP address to import its profile.
desktop.bambu_studio_certificate_failed: Could not safely read the TLS certificate. Ensure the printer is reachable on port 8883.
desktop.bambu_studio_identity_failed: The certificate does not contain the expected Bambu serial number. No details were imported.
desktop.bambu_studio_settings_missing: Bambu Studio settings were not found in the Windows profile.
desktop.bambu_studio_settings_invalid: The Bambu Studio settings file is damaged or has an unsupported format.
desktop.bambu_studio_profile_missing: The Bambu Studio profile does not match the printer certificate and IP address.
desktop.bambu_studio_profile_ambiguous: Bambu Studio contains conflicting access codes. Enter the code manually.
desktop.bambu_studio_import_failed: Could not safely import the settings. Enter the details manually.
desktop.bambu_studio_certificate_save_fa: Could not save the trusted certificate in the local UFM profile.
desktop.bambu_lan_notice: Enable LAN Mode. Autofill matches the serial number from the TLS certificate to the Bambu Studio profile; the code stays hidden and is stored in Windows Credential Locker only after a successful connection. A confirmed certificate is pinned by SHA-256; TLS verification is never disabled.
desktop.local_endpoint_notice: Only local OctoPrint and Moonraker addresses are supported. Connections are read-only; filament accounting is not changed automatically.
desktop.select_printer_first: Select a printer from the list first.
desktop.printer_status_failed: Could not retrieve printer status. Check the local network, LAN Mode, and TLS certificate trust.
desktop.printer_tls_failed: The printer presented a TLS certificate that Windows does not trust. The connection was aborted; TLS verification cannot be disabled. Select a verified certificate or certificate authority from the manufacturer or your network administrator.
desktop.printer_unavailable: The printer did not respond on the local network. Check the IP address, LAN Mode, serial number, and access code; ensure the PC and printer share the same network.
desktop.printer_invalid_observation: The printer connected but did not send the expected status snapshot. Check the serial number and firmware compatibility. Settings were not saved.
desktop.bambu_access_code_required: Enter the access code from the printer settings.
desktop.bambu_required_fields: Enter the printer name, model, IP address, serial number, and access code. No printer connection has been attempted yet.
desktop.printer_auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check the printer access code or API token.
desktop.printer_connection_failed: Could not verify the printer ({reason}). Make sure it is reachable on your local network.
desktop.printer_setup_failed: Could not save the printer settings or protected token.
desktop.printer_added_result: The connection to {name} ({provider}) at {endpoint} was verified. Monitoring is read-only.
desktop.new_spool_profile_notice: Choose a material profile. To add a new filament type, import the Spoolman catalog first.
desktop.no_material_profiles: The catalog has no materials yet. Import a Spoolman database to add material profiles.
desktop.spool_created_result: The spool was added to local inventory. If you did not enter opening stock, you can establish it separately.
desktop.spool_created_opening_failed: The spool was created, but its opening stock could not be recorded. Set stock using the Change stock action.
desktop.select_spool_first: Select a spool from the list first.
desktop.opening_stock_notice: Enter the current known amount. This establishes the spool's opening balance.
desktop.manual_stock_notice: Manual deduction is not automatic print accounting. Automatic deduction requires verified printer data.
desktop.confirm_opening: Set an opening balance of {amount} g for "{spool}"?
desktop.confirm_add: Add {amount} g to the stock of "{spool}"?
desktop.amount_must_be_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.
desktop.stock_deduction_exceeds_availabl: This deduction exceeds available stock after reservations.
desktop.opening_stock_required: Set this spool's opening stock before making a change.
desktop.opening_stock_already_set: Opening stock is already established. Use add stock or manual deduction instead.
desktop.stock_saved_result: The change was recorded in the append-only inventory ledger.
desktop.inventory_operation_failed: The inventory operation failed. The error is shown below.
desktop.printer_monitoring_notice: Connections are verified locally. Current printer support is read-only; automatic filament accounting is not enabled yet.
desktop.select_spoolman: Select the existing Spoolman SQLite database
desktop.database_error: The local inventory could not be read.
desktop.import_invalid: This database is damaged or uses an unsupported Spoolman schema. No import was started.
desktop.import_failed: Import did not complete. Check the verified backups before retrying; some individually committed spool records may already have been imported.
cli.help:
Usage: ufm [--check|--catalog|--qr-label UUID|--spoolman-preview PATH|--spoolman-db-preview PATH|--spoolman-db-import PATH|--haspelsync-preview PRINTERS_JSON MAPPINGS_JSON ID_MAP_JSON] [--spoolman-source-id ID|new] [--locale uk-UA|en-US] [--data-dir PATH] [--version]

--check     Validate startup without creating application directories.
--catalog   Print offline reference materials as JSON; no stock changes.
--qr-label UUID  Print a spool QR label as SVG; no file writes.
--spoolman-preview PATH --source-instance NAME  Preview an explicit Spoolman JSON response file.
--spoolman-db-preview PATH  Validate a Spoolman SQLite database without writes; show registered source keys and the path-derived suggestion.
--spoolman-db-import PATH --spoolman-source-id ID  Import under the selected source key; reuse the same ID after moving the database file.
--spoolman-db-import PATH --spoolman-source-id new  Create a separate source for another Spoolman installation.
--locale    Choose Ukrainian or English.
--data-dir  Use an explicit application root directory.
--haspelsync-preview PRINTERS_JSON MAPPINGS_JSON ID_MAP_JSON  Preview printer and slot compatibility locally; no network, secret output or inventory writes.
--version   Show the application version.
--help      Show this help.
error.arguments: Invalid arguments. Use --help for available options.
error.interoperability: The catalog, label identity or inventory input is invalid or unavailable. No stock was changed.
error.spoolman_import: The Spoolman import failed. Check the verified backups before retrying; the import may have committed individual spool records.
error.settings: The settings file is invalid or cannot be read.
error.startup: Startup failed. Check access to the application directories.
error.localization: Translation resources are missing or invalid.
desktop.network_autofill_failed: Could not identify one printer. Enter its local IP and check LAN Mode. For multiple printers, select an address from discovery results.
desktop.network_autofilled: Printer identified through network discovery and its TLS certificate. Enter the LAN code from the printer or import it from Bambu Studio. The code stays masked.
secrets.unavailable: Secure credential storage is unavailable. Connections requiring credentials are disabled.
desktop.import_source_prompt: Choose a registered source to preserve the same IDs after moving its database. An unverified snapshot may mean an interrupted or legacy import; select that source to review/resume it. Create a new source for a separate Spoolman installation.
desktop.import_source_recovery_counts: preliminary spool reconciliation: matched {matched}/{total}, mismatched {mismatch}, missing {missing}, extra {extra}
